verdict.rationale: Alerting is a fair axis for an observability platform like Braintrust, but the pack documents no alert rules or thresholds and no notification channels such as Slack, PagerDuty or email. The closest items are real-time tracking of latency, cost and quality, dashboards, and a vague mention of configuring monitoring via MCP. None of these establishes threshold alerts or outbound notifications.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set alerts on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops and get notified in Slack, PagerDuty, or email
